rules.floor_value: Rating exactly 10, the lowest value the file uses for that field (nothing below it). Appears on vehicles the game did not really rate.
rules.implausible_estimate: Estimate more than 10x the median of that field across all vehicles (e.g. bicycle quarter-mile ≈ 2092).
rules.type_inapplicable: Land-driving stat on a watercraft or aircraft: braking 60-0, road/off-road estimates, road/off-road ratings.
